## Overview

This week, we will learn how to work with **tabular data** in R,
and how to visualize data with the _ggplot2_ package of the _tidyverse_.
We'll do this by exploring the gene count table
from the RNA-seq data set that you've been working with.

## Learning goals

Some of the things you will learn this week:

#### [Working with tabular data in R](./w13a_data-wrangling.qmd)

- The vector data structure, R's main data types, and comparisons
- How to read files with tabular data, and look at them in Positron's Data Explorer
- How to subset, sort, modify, summarize, reshape, and join data frames
- How to write data frames to files

#### [Data visualization in R with _ggplot2_](./w13b_data-viz.qmd)

- Basic syntax of the `ggplot()` function, including aesthetic mappings
- How to create scatter plots, bar graphs, and box plots
- How to customize plots with colors, labels, and themes,
  and how to change the order of categories
- How to export plots to files

## Assignments and exercises

- **Week 13 exercises**: [R data wrangling and visualization](./w13_exercises.qmd) ---
  These also cover the week 12 material.

## Optional self-study material

- [Additional R material](/bonus/r.qmd) ---
  More on vectors, factors, and data wrangling,
  and more plotting, including color palettes, custom themes, histograms,
  faceting, and combining plots.
